# Evaluation and observability

English · [Русский](../ru/themes/evals-observability.md) · ← [AI Interview Atlas](../../README.md)

Knowing whether an AI system works: eval sets, LLM judges, regression gates, online measurement and production traces.

## Both tracks

- **How would you build a useful evaluation set when reference answers are missing and expert time is scarce?**
  - Applied scenario
  - Tests: Whether sampling and annotation effort target consequential uncertainty.
- **Design a release gate for prompt and model updates, including what happens when aggregate gains hide a critical regression.**
  - System design · Asked at: [Anthropic](../companies/anthropic.md) †
  - Tests: Whether release decisions account for failure severity and uncertainty.
  - A strong answer covers:
    - Version the candidate, baseline, dataset and graders.
    - Set acceptance rules for critical slices and repeated stochastic trials.
    - Combine offline results with a monitored rollout and explicit rollback criteria.
  - Read: [Demystifying evals for AI agents](https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/demystifying-evals-for-ai-agents) (Anthropic)
- **Benchmark results improve but users report a worse product. What hypotheses would you test first?**
  - Applied scenario
  - Tests: Whether evaluation coverage is connected to actual user tasks.
  - A strong answer covers:
    - Compare benchmark tasks and traffic with actual user workflows.
    - Check leakage, slice regressions, latency and changes in user expectations.
    - Reproduce complaints and add representative failures without overfitting the test set.
  - Read: [Rules of Machine Learning](https://developers.google.com/machine-learning/guides/rules-of-ml) (Google for Developers)
- **Design online evaluation for an AI feature: choose what to log, review manually and compare in an experiment.**
  - System design · Asked at: [Perplexity](../companies/perplexity.md) †
  - Tests: Whether experimental outcomes are distinguished from passive correlations.
- **A customer reports worse answers after a model upgrade. How do you verify the regression and decide what to restore or change?**
  - Applied scenario · Asked at: [OpenAI](../companies/openai.md) †
  - Tests: Whether concrete customer failures drive reproduction and remediation.
- **How would you change evaluation when an LLM workflow moves from suggesting actions to executing them in production?**
  - System design · Asked at: [Palantir](../companies/palantir.md) †
  - Tests: Whether action consequences change the acceptance criteria.

## AI Engineering

- **Design an LLM judge and a calibration process that exposes order, verbosity and self-preference biases.**
  - System design · Asked at: [Perplexity](../companies/perplexity.md) †
  - Tests: Whether model judgements are validated against independent labels.
  - A strong answer covers:
    - Define a task-specific rubric and a held-out human-labelled calibration set.
    - Randomise answer order and test sensitivity to length and model identity.
    - Measure disagreements and use expert review where automated judgement is unreliable.
  - Read: [Judging LLM-as-a-Judge with MT-Bench and Chatbot Arena](https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.05685) (Zheng et al., arXiv)
- **How would you measure unsupported claims in a deployed RAG application without treating every fluent answer as correct?**
  - System design · Asked at: [Anthropic](../companies/anthropic.md) †, [OpenAI](../companies/openai.md) †
  - Tests: Whether faithfulness to evidence is separated from fluency and general plausibility.
- **How does benchmark contamination distort evaluation, and how would you reduce leakage into training or model selection?**
  - Knowledge
  - Tests: Whether repeated tuning on test data is recognised as leakage.
- **Design observability for a production LLM workflow: which spans, versions, costs and feedback should be linked?**
  - System design
  - Tests: Whether a failed user task can be reconstructed without indiscriminate sensitive logging.
  - A strong answer covers:
    - Link model, retrieval and tool spans to one task identifier and version set.
    - Record latency, token use, outcomes and sampled feedback with retention controls.
    - Use traces to diagnose stage failures and convert recurring failures into eval cases.
  - Read: [Site Reliability Engineering](https://sre.google/sre-book/table-of-contents/) (Google) · [Demystifying evals for AI agents](https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/demystifying-evals-for-ai-agents) (Anthropic)
- **How would you version prompts and dependent configuration so an observed regression can be rolled back reproducibly?**
  - System design
  - Tests: Whether rollback restores the actual system configuration.
- **How should evaluation of a tool-using agent differ from grading one generated response?**
  - System design
  - Tests: Whether final state, trajectory and repeated-run reliability are all inspected.
  - A strong answer covers:
    - Check the final environment state, not just the agent's success message.
    - Grade task completion separately from unsafe or wasteful trajectories.
    - Repeat trials and report reliability across runs with clean, controlled environments.
  - Read: [Demystifying evals for AI agents](https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/demystifying-evals-for-ai-agents) (Anthropic)
- **Design an experiment for a suspected emergent capability or bias in a large model, with controls against misleading task framing.**
  - Applied scenario · Asked at: [Anthropic](../companies/anthropic.md) †
  - Tests: Whether a capability claim is testable and alternative explanations are considered.
- **Build the evaluation harness for a new model release, covering reproducibility, execution isolation and comparable results.**
  - System design · Asked at: [Google and Google DeepMind](../companies/google.md) †
  - Tests: Whether evaluation infrastructure can support trustworthy comparisons.
- **Two qualified clinicians produce different good notes from the same consultation. How would you evaluate a generated note fairly?**
  - Applied scenario
  - Tests: Whether evaluation permits valid variation while checking omissions and unsupported content.
